shortDescription: On Polymarket, the “Yes” probability for “Fight to Go the Distance” in the UFC 333 lightweight preliminary bout between Grant Dawson and Nurullo Aliev fell from 99.85% one hour ago to 50.55%. According to ChainCatcher, the probability change was 49.3 percentage points.
